data.long_description:
Discover a sophisticated residence in the iconic St. Regis The Palm, positioned on a high floor with stunning panoramic views over Palm Jumeirah and the Arabian Gulf.

This beautifully redesigned apartment spans 1,035 sqft and has been thoughtfully curated with luxury finishes, custom furnishings, and advanced smart-home technology, creating a seamless blend of elegance and comfort.

Property Highlights:
• High-floor unit with exceptional sea and Palm views
• Spacious and efficient layout
• Fully furnished with designer interiors
• Private parking space
• Premium integrated kitchen appliances

Interior & Upgrade Features:
• Intelligent home automation system controlling lighting, climate, and curtains
• Built-in projector for a private cinema experience
• Separate sound systems for bedroom and living area
• Motorized curtains throughout the apartment
• High-end Bosch appliances including a wine cooler
• Bespoke sofa crafted with luxury Belgian performance fabric
• Curated original artwork with authenticity certification
• Refined marble detailing, custom shelving with ambient lighting, and handcrafted decorative elements throughout the residence

Residents of St. Regis The Palm enjoy world-class amenities including signature concierge services, valet parking, luxury wellness facilities, swimming pool, modern fitness center, and direct connectivity to Nakheel Mall.

An exceptional opportunity to own or rent a turnkey luxury home in one of Dubai’s most prestigious destinations.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
